hints.title: Reverse Monotonic Processing
hints.text: The last element can remain unchanged because replacing it only lowers the ceiling for preceding elements.

hints.title: Equipartition Splits
hints.text: When nums[i] exceeds the current right upper bound, split nums[i] into parts = (nums[i] + bound - 1) // bound equal or nearly equal pieces.

hints.title: Updated Bound
hints.text: Splitting nums[i] into parts pieces requires parts - 1 operations, and sets the new right upper bound to nums[i] // parts.

hints.title: Backward Greedy Splits Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Splitting elements from left to right creates unnecessary cascading splits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that greedy backward traversal maximizing the smallest part is optimal.
